description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans serialization system, specifically testing converter-based serialization mechanisms for foreign library types, including codecs and copiers for various type wrappers and derived types.

classes.name: ConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for converter-based serialization of MyForeignLibraryType.

classes.name: ConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying MyForeignLibraryType instances.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for wrapped converter codecs for WrapsMyForeignLibraryType.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying wrapped MyForeignLibraryType instances.

classes.name: StructConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for struct-based converter codecs for MyForeignLibraryValueType.

classes.name: StructConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying MyForeignLibraryValueType instances.

classes.name: WrappedStructConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for wrapped struct converter codecs for WrapsMyForeignLibraryValueType.

classes.name: WrappedStructConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying wrapped MyForeignLibraryValueType instances.

classes.name: DerivedConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for converter codecs for derived types from MyForeignLibraryType.

classes.name: DerivedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying derived type instances.

classes.name: CombinedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for copying instances of MyFirstForeignLibraryType.
